name: River Number 2 Beach
description: Often rated Africa's best beach - white sand, turquoise blue water.
longDescription: River Number 2 is jewel of Salone. Green jungle meets white sand and blue Atlantic.

name: Tokeh Beach
description: Wide white beach with luxury eco-lodges, 8km pristine.
longDescription: Tokeh is luxury meets nature. Wide white beach, green hills behind.

name: Bunce Island
description: Historic slave castle - UNESCO heritage site.
longDescription: Bunce Island was major slave trading post. Ruins tell story of unity.

name: Tacugama Chimpanzee Sanctuary
description: Rescue sanctuary for endangered chimps in green rainforest.
longDescription: In green hills above Freetown, Tacugama rescues chimps. Forest trails.

name: Lumley Beach
description: City beach - vibrant, bars, street food, sunset.
longDescription: Freetown main beach. Flags, fishing boats, grilled fish, nightlife.

name: Gola Rainforest
longDescription: Gola is green heart. Pygmy hippos, forest elephants, canopy.

name: Outamba-Kilimi Park
longDescription: Savanna meets rainforest. Boat safari to see hippos and elephants.

name: Banana Islands
longDescription: Dublin, Ricketts islands. No cars, just blue water, white sand.

name: Tiwai Island
longDescription: Tiwai means Big Island. Surrounded by Moa River blue waters.

name: Cotton Tree and Museum
description: Symbol of freedom - 500-year-old tree site and museum.
longDescription: Historic heart. Cotton Tree site and National Museum with artifacts.

name: Loma Mountains
description: Highest peak in West Africa - 1945m hiking adventure.
longDescription: Green mountains rising above blue horizon. Challenge hike to Bintumani.

name: John Obey Beach
description: Surfer's beach - long white sand and blue waves.
longDescription: John Obey combines fishing culture with surf. White sand, blue waves.

name: National Museum
description: Houses Sierra Leone's rich cultural artifacts and history.
longDescription: Find National Monuments, and so many touristic interests in Freetown museum.

name: Bureh Beach
description: Famous surfing beach and host of annual Bureh Beach Carnival.
longDescription: Surfing capital of Sierra Leone with vibrant carnival culture.

name: Fourah Bay College
description: First university in West Africa, founded in 1827.
longDescription: Historic Fourah Bay College - Athens of West Africa with colonial architecture.
